_comment: Committed, known-good Confluence pages for the `render` suite's per-macro
fixtures, keyed by APP profile id (config/apps.ts APP_PROFILES) then macro
type. This file exists ONLY because the project's e2e test pages are never
deleted: without it, every CI run of the render suite would create 5 brand
new permanent Confluence pages, forever. tests/render/pages.setup.ts reuses
an id here after confirming (GET /wiki/api/v2/pages/{id}) it still exists
and is `status: current`; a stale or missing id self-heals by falling
through to creating a fresh page.
This file is NOT authoritative by construction — it is authoritative
because pages.setup.ts prints a loud console line whenever it has to create
a page a fixture here should have covered. Whoever sees that line is the
one who keeps this file current; there is no other update path.
